media.title:
ULTIMATE WASHINGTON ROAD TRIP👇

📌 Save this for your road trip planning

I’ve lived in Washington for 5 years and these are the spots you absolutely can’t miss ⬇️

Follow @dashingaroundtheglobe for more Washington hiking and outdoor adventures 🌲

🩵 Diablo Lake - this is easily the most stunning lake in the entire state and a great place to start your North Cascades National Park adventure 
🔥 Baker Hot Springs - this spot is a true hidden gem, after only a 10min walk from the parking lot you can have a private soak 
🌷 Skagit Valley - visit this area in April to see Washington’s famous tulips 
🌁 Deception Pass - Washington’s most popular state park with stunning blue water, easy trails and a quiet beach makes for a great day trip
🏝️ Bainbridge Island - you need to take a ferry to get here, but it’s so worth it! This small island is great to explore by bike, foot, or car
🌙 Lake Crescent - spend a weekend camping here and boating on the lake 
🌿 Hoh Rainforest - is on the largest rainforests in the US and is known as one of the wettest place in the world! Bring your rain boots and come explore this unique natural ecosystem 
❤️ Ruby beach - roast some s’mores over a campfire in one the best sunset spots in Washington 
🏔️ Paradise - The Paradise corridor in Mt Rainier national park has some of the best hikes in the state, many of which are beginner and family friendly!
🌄 Mt Fremont Fire Lookout - this is by far the best sunset spot in the entire state!
💧Snoqualmie Falls - you can see these 270 foot falls without any hiking and parking is free!
💜 Pete Lake - an easy hike leads you to the most stunning sunrise and sunset spot in the state 
🇩🇪 Leavenworth - this Bavarian themed town is fun for the whole family year round

This is my 5th and final part of this series, pulling in all the best spots across Washington into one video! Let me know if you think I missed anything🌲 

Where would you go first? 🤔

#washingtonstate #roadtrip #outdooradventures

Эрэгтэйчүүд 
Нийлбэр дүнгээр түрүүлсэн Ганэрдэнэ Seattle,удаалсан Цолмон Seattle,3- р байранд шалгарсан Баттөмөр Seattle,4- р байрт шалгарсан Монгол улсын дугуйн спортын дэд мастер Энхбадраа,Seattle,
5 -р байрт шалгарсан Осор Seattle,6- р байрт шалгарсан Ундрах Denver, Энэ шагналт байрын эзэддээ Амеркын Монгол дугуйчидын холбооноос талархал дэвшүүлж ирээдүйн мастер болхыг хүсэе .
